inputs.text: I heard about this massive anti-Trump protest that started as a huge "No Kings" rally, with crowds packing the streets to challenge entrenched power. Federal officers wasted no time responding with tear gas and arrests, escalating everything into chaos before ordering people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the exact kind of state violence we've come to expect from institutions designed to protect inequality and crush any real push for justice. When vulnerable communities demand protection from systemic harm, the response is always repression to keep the powerful in control.

subtopics: Use of tear gas and arrests
